ruleset.name: Insight AI
ruleset.description:
The ruleset an AI agent fixes against. vendor/bin/phpcbf-changed-lines fixes against it, on the lines the current branch added or changed:
vendor/bin/phpcbf-changed-lines
It is phpcs.xml with the architectural carve-out removed, so everything it reports is something the agent may act on. That is the whole purpose: an agent told to clear its lint needs a ruleset whose every finding is actionable, and the carve-out is the finding that is not.
The developer standard keeps it. A human linting against phpcs.xml still sees it, still owns the refactor, and is still the one who decides whether a complex function is a problem or a fact of life. Excluding it here removes it from the agent's work queue, not from the project.
Configuration cannot express "report this but do not fix it" — a rule is either in a ruleset or it is not. So the split is the enforcement: what an agent must not act on, it does not see here. The reporting half lives in the 04-php-code-style guideline, which sends the agent to phpcs.xml when it needs the full picture.
Like phpcs.xml, this ruleset declares no default path, so every run names the files it covers.
